items.company: DeepSeek / 腾讯 / 宁德时代
items.text: 彭博10-22报道，DeepSeek新一轮融资已筹得约1000亿元人民币（约150亿美元），是中国规模最大的融资之一；知情人士称目标从500亿元两次上调到800亿元、最终约1000亿元，宁德时代和腾讯是最大出资方之一。10-6彭博/路透曾报「接近完成至少800亿元」，本次为完成口径；DeepSeek、腾讯、宁德时代均未回应置评，属媒体援引知情人士。
items.translation_zh: 中国AI先锋DeepSeek在最新一轮融资中筹集约1000亿元人民币（150亿美元），是中国有史以来规模最大的融资之一，显示其与Anthropic、OpenAI在全球竞争的雄心。知情人士称，这家杭州公司在与投资者洽谈期间至少两次上调融资目标，从500亿元到800亿元，最终达到该数字；宁德时代和腾讯是本轮最大投资者之一。DeepSeek、腾讯和宁德时代代表未回复置评请求。
items.original: The Chinese AI pioneer DeepSeek has raised about 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) in its latest fundraising round, one of the country's largest ever and a sign of the startup's ambitions to compete globally with the likes of Anthropic PBC and OpenAI. The Hangzhou-based firm boosted its financing target at least twice as it talked with investors, from 50 billion yuan to 80 billion yuan before reaching the final tally, according to people familiar with the matter. Battery pioneer Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. and WeChat-operator Tencent Holdings Ltd. were among the biggest investors in the round... DeepSeek, Tencent and CATL representatives didn't respond to emailed requests for comment.
